# Kaizenly

> Kaizenly is a strict, local-first focus guard for Android, built by Nadeem
> Mazhar (Nadeem Dev Apps), a solo developer in Pakistan. Pick a duration and
> a bag of distracting apps; they stay blocked until the session ends.
> Leaving early costs parachutes. Your data never leaves your device.

- [Overview](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/): A little better, every day. Timed sessions, bags of blocked apps, routines, the Tower streak, and parachutes earned free by focusing.
- [Privacy Policy](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/privacy/): Kaizenly collects almost nothing. Sessions, bags, routines, and settings live on your device; there is no account, no analytics, no tracking.
- [Terms of Use](https://nadeemdevapps.github.io/my-web/products/kaizenly/terms/): Kaizenly is provided as-is. Sessions are designed to be hard to break: leaving early costs a parachute.

## Key facts

- Free in this version: all 3 bags with 6 slots each, 3 routines (each routine its own bag), all 4 soundscapes (Rain, Waves, White Noise, City), and parachutes earned free by the parachute streak.
- Parachute streak: a qualifying day is a day with at least one session of 30 minutes of actual focus. First 10 days pay double (day 3 earns +2; day 10 earns +6 with its bonus; cumulative totals 3→2, 6→8, 10→20, 15→25, 20→35, 30→45). A missed day resets the streak to 0; Tower reserve blocks do not save it. Cap 99.
- Parachute costs: a 30-minute break costs 1; exiting early costs 1 + 1 per hour left (minimum 2); holding to extend and starting a session over 3 hours need one on board (not consumed); enabling a routine needs one.
- Still Premium: sessions up to 12 hours (custom card) and silence / Do Not Disturb during sessions. Premium is Rs 1,450 one-time and arrives with Play Billing.
- The Tower: 5 minutes of focus a day lays one block; 7 blocks make a floor; 3 reserve blocks are spent automatically on missed days; 10 days in a row restores one spent reserve.
- The daily streak: 1 minute a day keeps it alive; 5 minutes on the first day; weeks run Monday to Sunday; an evening reminder at 8:30 PM.
- Local-first: no account, no sign-up, no server, no analytics, no ads, no trackers. Backup is a local JSON file you export and import yourself.
- Enforcement: accessibility service guards, notification shade / recents / power menu close, floating windows dismissed, a 15-second watchdog, a guardian fallback, boot restore, up to 3 × 60-second settings passes per session.
- Sessions: presets 15 minutes, 45 minutes, 3 hours; a wheel with up to 3 of your own presets (1–720 minutes); slide to start; hold 3 seconds to extend +15 minutes (up to +60 per session).
- Stats: Day / Month / Year. Widgets: a preset widget (up to 3 presets) and a streak widget (last 28 days).
- Theme: Light, Automatic, Dark. A fresh install starts in Light.

## Notes

- The site is a static Astro site. Design tokens live in DESIGN.md in this folder.
- The brand mark is three stacked parallelogram tiles forming a K, with the green tile in #27F24C; the wordmark is drawn in the app's own 3×5 tile alphabet, with the centre tile of the Z in green.
